claims.claim: A campaign was reported active as of September 22, 2026.
claims.safeFraming: attribute to the reports; do not assert independent verification by LAiDIES.

claims.claim: Gambit reports more than 600,000 credit-card records from two companies.
claims.safeFraming: “Gambit reports” rather than an unqualified incident total.

claims.claim: Gambit says it confirmed some skimmers and linked more sites through associated indicators.
claims.safeFraming: do not collapse confirmed, linked, and estimated site counts into one independently verified total.

claims.claim: Gambit describes three AI harnesses for scanning, exploitation, and orchestration, with a human operator setting brief goals.
claims.safeFraming: describe assisted/autonomous task execution, not an AI acting without a human or an identified model/provider causing the incident.

claims.claim: The $7,005.71 four-week model-access figure is described as captured; the $12,000–$18,000 total and per-target economics are estimates.

excludedClaims: That any named retailer, reader, or card issuer was affected.
That the campaign’s full scope, actor identity, motive, or model-provider attribution has been independently verified.
That every reported card record was current, usable, or connected to a particular reader.
Any exploit method, vulnerability, indicator, credential, evasion, or response instruction.
